description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service within a telemetry component, including function declarations for engaging with the message bus, initializing, finalizing, checking the bus, freeing resources, and handling messages via a DBus callback.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages with the message bus using specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus interface, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status or availability of the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources allocated with a given priority and user data.

methods.name: T2_path_message_func
methods.description: Handler function for processing incoming DBus messages.
